purpose: Make the already-canonical CORE-02A work-session memory useful during actual creative work: while the active Song has an open Session, let the artist append durable observations, decisions, rejected ideas, unresolved questions and MARKs through the normal /song surface, preserve them in exact chronological Session history across navigation and Quit/relaunch, and keep them explicitly separate from durable Song doctrine unless a later bounded promotion contract is selected.

lineage.outcome: An artist can capture the meaningful things that happen during a Song work Session without interrupting the work, lose none of them when leaving N0TE, and return to the exact Session history without those notes silently becoming permanent Artist/Song truth.
lineage.capability: Consumer-reachable append-only Session observations, decisions, rejected ideas, unresolved questions and MARKs

n0te2_dependencies: SONG-01A landed objective/debrief/next-action consumer Session flow
legacy_rejections: automatic DAW/project mutation from a MARK or decision
freeform scratch kinds outside the canonical enum
claiming suggestion/template/capture systems implemented from Session notes

completion_proof: the normal /song path shows a bounded capture control only while the active canonical Song has an open work Session

the artist can append exactly the canonical OBSERVATION, DECISION, REJECTED_IDEA, UNRESOLVED and MARK kinds using artist-readable labels without submitting a trusted raw Session ID or arbitrary scratch kind
each capture action is one-shot and server-bound to the exact open Session rendered by N0TE; stale Song/Session context, foreign Origin and replay fail closed
blank and oversized capture text is rejected without adding Session history; valid text is normalized consistently with the consumer shell's human-text contract
captured items render in exact chronological order on the open Session and remain visible after navigation and explicit Quit/relaunch
captured history remains visible when the Session is later closed so the debrief and next action retain the context of what happened during the work
raw Session item IDs, profile IDs and internal evidence keys are not exposed in the primary consumer UI

capturing an item creates only canonical Session scratch/Activity history and does not automatically create EvidenceMemory claims, modify Song/version/assets, alter Headquarters Focus, create operations, connect providers or mutate a DAW
closed Sessions cannot receive new capture items and a stale pre-close action cannot append after close
multiple Artist profiles and Songs remain isolated; a server-bound action from one Song cannot append to another Song's Session
existing SONG-01A objective/debrief/next-action and UX-01C accessibility/security behavior remain intact
authored HTTP/invariant/stage-smoke proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
non_scope: Session-item promotion UI or raw evidence-key editing
Never Lose the Moment retrospective capture
next_selection_rule: After SONG-01B lands, globally reselect. Do not automatically continue into Session promotion: first compare explicit durable-memory semantics, version/asset continuity, template/suggestion product-model work, DAW-00, OPS-04 and other ready outcomes by customer value and truthful substrate.
